feeds.title: Weight Loss Specialists of North Texas Blog
feeds.description: If a struggle with obesity is part of your story, you don't have to hide. You can lose weight, regain your health, improve your quality of life and feel great about yourself. Discover your best you today! At Weight Loss Specialists of North Texas, there is No blame. No shame. Just compassionate care that gets results.

feeds.title: West Texas Bariatrics Blog
feeds.description: At West Texas Bariatrics, our team of expert physicians is passionate about helping those who are struggling with obesity. feeds.title: Advanced Bariatric & Surgical Specialists Blog
feeds.description: Advanced Bariatric & Surgical Specialists primary mission is to take care of you and to assist you in all aspects related to your surgery or condition. Visits to the doctor can cause anxiety, and their job is to alleviate your fears and help you return to health as quickly as possible. While you may need surgery or additional testing to help you improve your quality of life, we will only recommend these courses of treatment if they are in your best interest.

feeds.title: El Paso Bariatric Surgery Blog

Dr. Clapp's clinical and research contributions to bariatric surgery have established him as an expert in the field.
